storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: A tinkling sweet laugh echoes hollowly, and a petite figure appears in dim candlelight. She is both the fear and desire of the condemned, the dew and poison for the dying, bringing sweet pain and romantic madness. The "snap" from her ever-present whip on the skin is an evil symphony playing in the darkness.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
Awakening Material: Silver Core #G752a, unearthed from a festering mud heap at the ruins of Londinium's Newgate Prison. Investigator @2 accidentally slipped on a shattered skull while walking through the dim, grimy prison corridor and stumbled upon it by chance.

The awakening result deviated from expectations—what emerged from the black D-Slime was not some vicious death-row convict or a hulking executioner, but a petite young maiden with a sly smile.

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
"Be wary of Pandia. Her danger is not reflected by her appearance. She's a demon."

These are the heartfelt words of countless investigators, born from bitter experience.

Pandia often creates sweet traps, luring other researchers or Awakeners into master-slave Contracts, then mercilessly manipulating their emotions and Souls.

Conversations with Pandia always end fruitlessly. She insists that she is merely spreading joy with her new lovers, and the Contracts are voluntary. After all, she also lets her slaves taste the sweet fruits.

However, there is someone at the school who can counter Pandia. Whenever Sorel passes by Pandia's dormitory, Pandia falls silent, no matter the topic. Rumor has it that Pandia once suffered a major setback while trying to beguile Sorel, but the truth remains a mystery.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
"O sinners, this is the abyss of Desire, the bottom of Hell. The black hound roars here, the stench spreads here, and the death knell tolls here. You have gathered here due to your indulgent desires and cruel actions, and what awaits you is suffering and death."

Pandia once served in Newgate Prison, the most oppressive, gloomy, and sunless filthy corner of Londinium. Once bloodied heavy criminals were shackled and stripped of their dignity, kneeling to her in the Maze-like cell area, kissing her leather boots, humbly calling themselves her servants.

Whenever a new execution took place, she would summon new death row inmates, asking them to appreciate their own demise. As the executed squirmed in the hemp rope, she liked to sit high up, watching the worst of the worst tremble in fear and desperation.

But there was also a "Hell Cat" who observed that Pandia came to the iron gate of Newgate Prison countless times, tiptoeing to gaze outside London, as if waiting for a visitor from afar.

"In fact, I too can only be, a part of the miserable dark and damp dungeon that I can never escape."

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
"Master, whip me."

The fire of desire burned in her eyes that should have dried up, melting wax dripping like tears.

Thirst, pain, curses, filth—all the humiliation she craved, all the pleasures she offered, finally arrived upon her in this moment.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: Welcome to my paradise! Now, are you ready for my whip?

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Yes, I'm getting hotter...

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: P-Please, I'm all filled up~

daily.title: Upgrade: III

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Feeling thirsty? Clean water is a rare luxury in the prison.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Now, who's the good {Male=boy,Female=girl}? Good {Male=boy,Female=girl}s don't give up halfway~

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: You must have fallen into my sweet trap already at this point, yes?

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: Keep going, just a little more~ We're almost at the peak of ecstasy~

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: You've worked so hard; it's time to enjoy the fruits of your labor, right? Come closer, I won't disappoint you~

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Want to enjoy me? Then become my slave. I'll make you melt with heat~

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: I want more slaves, I wanna hear their moans and pleas—Bring me more slaves, pretty please?

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: I'm so bored! Compared to those trembling big prisoners, this is just like playing house. Why don't you keep me company~

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: Do you want to know the truth? I hate prison, hate the darkness, and hate it so much that I could die. I want to be noticed. I want to be ignited...

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: I've been waiting for someone to teach me true love, pain, and desire. Can you fulfill my wish? Can you redeem me from this dark prison?

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Oh~ Still not satisfied? Come closer, I'll teach you true pleasure~

daily.title: Chat: About "N"
daily.unlockCondition: Unlocks after completing Main Story Chapter 7
daily.content: Ah, was that Mr. N who just walked us by? No, never mind. The last time I greeted him, he didn't recognize me... I waited for him in prison, hoping he would take me away, but he never came, not even during the riot.

daily.title: Chat: About Wanda
daily.content: I'm not like her. She only knows how to give you chills and fear. But me? I will give you a sacred, searing love.

daily.title: Chat: About Ogier
daily.content: Aww, you've got such a precious boy here! I asked him if he'd like to become my devoted slave, and he blushed, stammering so sweetly about having sworn his loyalty to you... As if true devotion can't be shared!

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: I hate that dark feeling, as if my heart has been hollowed out. The unfulfilled sensation makes my whole body itch...

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: This place is much better than the filthy, stinky New Gate Prison! Whether lounging on the sofa or squeezed into a corner, it's all quite comfortable, isn't it?

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: What do I love? I love the exquisite truth of pain. The beautiful, burning blush of swollen flesh... the way a moan cannot tell pleasure from agony. It's the only honest desire we have, don't you think?

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Don't let me near the water, okay? I'd hate for this delicious, burning love I have for you to be... quenched.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Our relationship? Do you even need to ask? It's exactly what you're imagining!
